summary: Isolate Python API demos from real queues and align supported API

delivery.outcome: Run every executable Python API demonstration in a disposable local queue without changing the caller project; supported TicketLogger operations succeed
nonGoals: No removal or attribution of historical sample tickets
No remote sync or changes to real project queues
No changes to other example directories

architecture.decision: Keep disposable cwd lifecycle in an example-only helper so auto-discovery, quick_ticket and TicketLogger use the same fresh local store
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded follow-up commit through protected publication.

validation.evidence: Actual example subprocesses preserve sentinel caller queue and restore cwd on error

commands: python -m ruff check --no-respect-gitignore examples/python-api planfile/extensions/__init__.py tests/test_python_api_examples.py
validation.evidence: Full suite and scope validation pass; exact-head protected CI before merge
